purpose: extend external-score information transfer to an explicitly supplied upstream refit ensemble while preserving row alignment, information nesting and the full group-by-step family
input_grain: one record per refit_id by held-out row_id pair
alignment_requirements: every refit contains exactly the same held-out row_id set
group metadata are identical for a row_id across all refits
resampling-block metadata are identical for a row_id across all refits
row weights are identical for a row_id across all refits
all information levels are scored on the same held-out row within a refit
refit_sampling_rule: one selected refit ID is shared across every independent group and every adjacent information step within a nested Monte Carlo draw
block_sampling_rule: within each independent group one validation-block resample is shared across every adjacent information step
certification_family: all estimable independent-group by adjacent-information-step cells
reported_ceilings: point transfer ceiling for every supplied refit
hard_stops: missing or extra held-out row in any refit
non-finite comparator score on a positive-weight row in any refit
non-finite richest-level score makes the affected group-step cell unavailable
